orders.carrier: The loads you handed to partners, and the ones somebody moves for you
orders.shipper: The loads your transporters move for you, inside or outside Appload

trips.carrier: The loads your own fleet moves, and the ones partners offered you
trips.shipper: The loads your own trucks move between your sites

search.placeholder: Search by reference, driver, plate or cargo

tiles.received-hint: Partners' loads waiting on your answer
tiles.confirmed-hint: Agreed with a partner, not booked in yet
tiles.booked-hint: Waiting for the truck at the loading site
tiles.in-progress-hint: From the loading site to offloading
tiles.delivered-hint: Arrived, waiting for the books to close
tiles.silent-hint: Drivers who have not answered yet

filters.silent-hint: In progress, asked for a position today and not answered yet
filters.off-route-hint: Reported from more than 10 km off the planned route
filters.has-costs-hint: Your loads with at least one cost line

empty.trips: Nothing on your trucks here yet

empty-description.orders: File a load a partner will move, and follow it from here.
empty-description.trips: File a load for your own trucks, and follow it from here.
empty-description.trips-carrier: The loads your clients hand you on the portal show up here once you accept them.

data.empty-disputes: When a company on a load opens a dispute on it, the load shows up here until the dispute is resolved.
data.error: The loads could not be loaded. Try again.

blockers.DISPUTE_OPEN: It can only be closed once the dispute on it is resolved.
blockers.UNSETTLED: It can only be closed once the payments are settled.

transition.flagged-title: Proceeding with {count, plural, one {# flag} other {# flags}}

consequence.starts-tracking: Tracking starts: the driver gets location requests on WhatsApp, and the load counts towards this month's plan.
consequence.starts-tracking-undriven: The load counts towards this month's plan, but with no driver named nobody can be asked where it is — name one and the location requests start.
consequence.cancelled: Everyone on this load is told, and a partner that already accepted it has it cancelled too.
consequence.closed: A closed load can no longer be changed.

offer.title: Offer the load
offer.description: {partner} gets the lane, the cargo, the dates and what it will be paid, and answers on the portal. The terms are locked while it decides.

respond.accept-description: {ref} becomes a trip of yours, with {owner} as the client. Next you name the driver and the truck.
respond.decline-placeholder: Why you cannot move this load

convert.to-partner-description: {ref} becomes an order with the same number, history and costs, and goes back to procurement until the partner is confirmed.
convert.to-own-fleet-description: {ref} becomes a trip on your own fleet. Whatever was agreed with the partner no longer applies.

confirmation.title: Send confirmation
confirmation.description: {partner} gets the confirmation of {ref} by email, and it is filed on the order.
confirmation.sent-simulated: Confirmation prepared — email is not configured on this environment

errors.email: The email was not sent. Check the address and try again.
errors.failed: The confirmation could not be sent. Try again.

money.title: Money
money.no-legs: No amounts recorded for this load yet.

blocked.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The two amounts are in different currencies, so no margin is worked out.
blocked.MISSING_LEG: The margin shows once both amounts are recorded.

fields.correction-hint: Takes the amount off instead of adding it. Give the reference of the payment it corrects.

fields.rechargeable-hint: It does not come out of the margin: the client pays it.

dialog.title: Add cost
dialog.description: What it cost to run this load. Only your company sees costs.

dialog.title: Add document
dialog.description: PDF, JPG or PNG. Choose who can see it.
dialog.hint: A shared proof of delivery reaches everyone on the load, including the end client.
dialog.format: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files are accepted.

tracking.title: Location
tracking.linked: The partner tracks its own truck; positions show here as they arrive.
tracking.disabled: Tracking is switched off for this load.
tracking.not-started: Positions start arriving once the truck is at the loading site
tracking.off-route: The truck last reported from more than 10 km off the planned route.

thread.title: Driver messages
thread.empty: No messages with the driver yet
thread.footer: Messages are sent from the load's tracking card and answered on WhatsApp.

actions.awarded: Quote picked; offered to the partner at its price

codes.EXECUTOR_WITHDREW: The transporter pulled out before its truck reached the loading site; the load can go to another partner.
codes.APPLOAD_BOOKED_ELSEWHERE: Appload placed this load with another transporter.
codes.APPLOAD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWN: The client took its request back.

detail.error: This load could not be opened. It may have been removed, or not be shared with you.

values.has-parent: This trip is your part of an order a client handed you on the portal.
values.linked: The partner accepted; the driver and the truck are theirs.

form.edit-description: Blocks that can no longer change are locked.

description.carrier: A load you hand to a partner. It stays with your company; Appload does not see it.
description.shipper: A load a transporter moves for you, or one on your own trucks. It stays with your company; Appload does not see it.

shape.label: Who moves it
shape.own-fleet-hint: A trip on your own trucks

fields.client-hint: A partner you are connected to, somebody off the portal, or your own company
fields.partner-hint: A transporter you are connected to, or somebody off the portal
fields.partner-on-portal: This transporter is on the portal: the load stays in procurement and you offer it from its page. They name their own driver.
fields.partner-ask-all: Every transporter you are connected to on the portal is asked what it would move the load for.
fields.partner-ask-one: This transporter is asked what it would move the load for, and answers on the portal.
fields.request-quotes-hint: The load goes out as a prospect; you pick a price from the quotes on its page. Untick to file it as a draft and offer it yourself.
fields.request-quotes-managed: Who is asked for a quote is managed from the Quotes card on the load's page: ask more transporters there, or withdraw one.
fields.driver-hint: From your drivers, or somebody you have not registered
fields.status-hint: You can move it on later from the load's page
fields.status-at-loading-hint: Tracking starts: the driver gets location requests and the load counts towards this month's plan
fields.notes-hint: Only your company sees the notes

errors.address: Pick an address from the list.
errors.name: Enter the name.

toasts.created-asked: {ref} filed — {count, plural, one {# transporter} other {# transporters}} asked for a quote
toasts.requested: Location request sent to the driver

status.procurement: The load is back in draft

banner.opened-unnamed: {reason} · opened by a company on this load on {date}

open.title: Open a dispute
open.description: Something went wrong with {ref}. The load cannot be closed until the dispute is resolved, and only your company can resolve it.
open.details-placeholder: What happened, when, and what is affected
open.shared: Both sides will see this: every company on this load reads it word for word.

resolve.title: Resolve the dispute
resolve.description: Say how it was settled. Every company on this load reads it, and the load can be closed again.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.empty: Nobody has been asked for a quote yet.
quotes.your-request: You were asked for a quote
quotes.open-load: Open the load to award one

toasts.sent: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody new was asked} one {Asked # transporter} other {Asked # transporters}}
toasts.awarded: Offer sent to the partner at its price

award.title: Award the load
award.description: {partner} is offered the load at the price it quoted and confirms on the portal. Every other transporter asked is told the round is over.

quote.title: Send a quote
quote.description: {owner} asked what you would move {ref} for. VAT included; the amount is what you would be paid.
quote.decline-description: {owner} is told you will not quote on {ref}.
quote.placeholder: Anything the client should know about your price

appload.sendDescription: Appload takes the load to its transporters and comes back with offers. The lane, the cargo and the dates go with it; what you pay is agreed on the offer you accept.
appload.pickerHint: Appload finds the transporter: sending it the load opens an Appload order, and the load is worked from that order.

errors.notFound: This load no longer exists, or is not shared with you.
errors.notAllowed: Your role in the company does not allow this.
errors.versionConflict: Somebody changed this load in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.invalidStatus: This is no longer possible where the load stands.
errors.closed: This load is closed and can no longer be changed.
errors.fieldLocked: Part of what you changed can no longer change on this load.
errors.partnerNotConnected: This company is not connected to you as a partner.
errors.partnerNotOnPortal: This partner is not on the portal; schedule the load directly.
errors.notACarrier: Only a transporter can be given a load.
errors.ownFleetHasNoCarrier: A trip on your own fleet has no partner and nothing to pay.
errors.ownTripsComeFromClients: A transporter's own trips come from its clients' orders.
errors.rigIsThePartners: The partner is on the portal and names its own driver and truck.
errors.executorDeparted: The transporter's truck is already on the load; only they can cancel it now.
errors.followsApploadOrder: This load follows its Appload order and is handled from there.
errors.apploadNeedsDetails: Appload needs the loading date, the category, the cargo and its weight before it can take the load out.
errors.apploadNotAClient: Appload moves loads; it is never the client of one.
errors.rigNotRegistered: The driver or truck picked is not in your fleet.
errors.noDriver: Name the driver and their phone first.
errors.noCarriersToAsk: None of your transporters is on the portal yet, so there is nobody to ask for a quote.
errors.apploadNotACandidate: Appload is offered a load from its page, not asked for a quote.
errors.notQuoted: This transporter has not named a price yet.
errors.noCarrier: Name the partner that will move the load first.
errors.noPrice: Record what you will pay the partner first.
errors.unsettled: It can only be closed once the payments are settled.
errors.disputeOpen: It can only be closed once the dispute on it is resolved.
errors.disputeExists: This load is already in a dispute.
errors.disputeInvalidLoad: A dispute can only be opened once the load is agreed.
errors.noSuchLeg: This load has no such amount recorded.
errors.legHasPayments: Payments are already recorded against this amount; it cannot be removed or change currency.
errors.paymentBelowZero: The correction would take the total paid below zero.
errors.invalidDocument: The document was not accepted. Upload it again.
errors.notApprovable: This photo is already approved, or is not a loading photo.
errors.notTrackable: Location can only be asked for on a load in progress with a driver.
errors.rateLimited: You have asked for the location several times already. Try again later.
errors.infobipNotConfigured: WhatsApp is not set up on this environment.
errors.subscriptionRequired: A plan is needed to track loads.
errors.quotaExceeded: This month's plan is used up.
errors.sendFailed: The request was saved, but the message did not reach the driver.
